title: Modular A/V: Vines theme
description: Cameras framed in branches that look grown, with ivy, for the Modular A/V dock: a frame of its own shape round each scattered camera, one shared lattice when docked. The ivy turns to autumn while its player is muted, and a soft light shows on the picture while they speak. Best with the scattered layout.

facts.label: Who picks it
facts.value: The GM, as the table's look, or each player
